Device Fleet Management

Remote management and OTA updates for connected device fleets

A device fleet management platform for organizations managing connected hardware at scale — enabling remote diagnostics, OTA firmware updates, and fleet-wide health monitoring.

Problem: Companies with dozens or hundreds of deployed devices have no central way to monitor health, push updates, or diagnose failures remotely.

Features: OTA firmware updates, Remote diagnostics, Fleet health dashboard, Alert management, Device provisioning, Audit logs.

Target users: IoT product companies, utilities with field devices, manufacturers with remote equipment.

Who is Device Fleet Management for? IoT product companies, utilities with field devices, manufacturers with remote equipment

What problem does this product solve? Companies with dozens or hundreds of deployed devices have no central way to monitor health, push updates, or diagnose failures remotely.

Can AICORE customise this product? Yes. AICORE can adapt product workflows, integrations, dashboards, user roles, and deployment details around your organisation's requirements.
